name: Liquid keys
desc: Warm liquid drum & bass piano: lush maj9/min9 block chords walking Bbmaj9-Gm9-Ebmaj9-F9, one per bar, struct-driven and gently pumped, ringing into an orbit-4 delay. An octave off-canon adds sparkle; every-4 fifth-lifts push the harmony at phrase ends.

code.full: note("<[bb3,d4,f4,a4,c5] [g3,bb3,d4,f4,a4] [eb4,g4,bb4,d5] [f3,a3,c4,eb4,g4]>").struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ ~").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(${len}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(24)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).delay(.25).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.28).off(1/4, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.4)).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[bb3,d4,f4,a4,c5] [g3,bb3,d4,f4,a4] [eb4,g4,bb4,d5,f5] [f3,a3,c4,eb4,g4]>").struct("x ~ x [~ x] ~ x [x x] x").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(${len}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.8).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(${room}).delay(.25).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.3).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.35)).every(4, x=>x.add(note(7))).orbit(4).play()
